original.edition: arXiv v1, 18 December 2001, p.2, equations 4--5, visually inspected. Publisher PDF was inaccessible (ADS 403); publisher typesetting was not independently checked.

correction.citation: Vazquez-Semadeni et al. (2007), ApJ 657, 870--883, p.873, equations 3--4 and footnote 5
correction.finding: Footnote 5 identifies two typos in KI Eq.4 and attributes corrections to H. Koyama. Formula and footnote visually inspected. Cited only for correction provenance; no simulation added to atlas.
correction.formal_erratum_status: No separate journal erratum located in the arXiv record and targeted bibliographic/web searches on the review date. This does not establish that none exists.

iwasaki.finding: Same corrected coefficients, heating and pure-H equation of state; kappa=2500 sqrt(T). Page 2 visually inspected.

limitations: Local isobaric labels do not assert instability at all wavelengths; conduction stabilizes small scales.
Common-pressure stable roots do not imply a static conductive front at every pressure.
Uniform equilibrium has no conductive term. Static-front selection additionally uses Parker conductivity.
New diagnostic from the corrected model, not a claim to reproduce an original KI equilibrium figure or the 2D simulation.
